doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Good young trumpet players today
summary: Young praises young trumpeters in the Clayton-Hamilton band and Winston Bird, and hopes another Louis or Roy comes along.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: What do you think about any of the young trumpet players today?
Any of the young trumpet players today? Any of them catch your ear? Anybody that make you sit up and listen?

There some good young trumpet players in line, in what‘s-his-name‘s band, in Jimmy‘s, I mean in Clayton-Hamilton‘s band. There‘s three or four good young trumpet player in there and there‘s another young trumpet player from, I can‘t think of his name…it‘s Winston, Winston Bird. Do you know Winston Bird?

He‘s a good young trumpet player. He‘s got chops [shoo]. These cats, I don‘t know where they get these chops from now-a-days. There must be something different about these chops because they all whistling up there, I say, ―Wow.‖ I like some of the young trumpet players. And I can, I tell when they blowing and when they sound good, I like them, you know, I like to see the cats blow, have another batch coming along, you know, another Louis or another Roy coming up, we‘ve got have. You know what I‘m saying. The should anyway.
